title: 바빌론 부자들의 돈 버는 지혜 — 우화 재무규칙·복리 가정의 경계
core_message: 1926 George S Clason financial fables teach saving10%, budgets, debt20%, avoiding fraudulent returns, but fictional Babylon setting not direct historical 6000yo evidence. Monthly1700000 on principal 340m implies 6% annual initial withdrawal and cannot be guaranteed perpetual; 20m at fixed5.8% for50y is ~335.2m hypothetical. Video sponsorship disclosed.
